chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever extends a favor to any one of my Ahl al-Bayt, I will repay him on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: My household, referring to the Prophet’s family
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.كَافَيْتُهُ: I will personally repay or recompense him
key_terms.يَدًا: A favor, act of help, or benefaction
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: The Day of Judgment, when final recompense is given

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for doing good to the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages doing good to the Ahl al-Bayt by promising the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله himself will recompense such kindness on the Day of Judgment. It highlights both the lofty rank of his household and the immense spiritual reward tied to honoring and supporting them.
